deliverables.change_summary: Added `tracing::info!(target: "pi.runtime.dispatch_mode_switch", ...)` event emission at the regime-shift-driven dispatch mode switch point. The event captures from_mode, to_mode, trigger=rollout_gate_decision, and confirmation_streak. The wiring (CUSUM/BOCPD → rollout gate → dispatch mode) was already present; this bead adds the missing telemetry event so production traffic can be observed.

next_actions: Run `cargo check --lib` and the full test suite to confirm the change compiles.
Add a regression test that drives a synthetic CUSUM spike and asserts the dispatch_mode_switch event fires with from_mode=sequential_fast_path, to_mode=interleaved_batching.
